    # So we need to reprocess queries while keeping track of cumulative sums

    earnings = [0]*(N+1)
    businessman_total = [0]*M
    businessman_factory = [[] for _ in range(M+1)]
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        b = B[i-1]
        businessman_factory[b].append(i)

    businessman_cumulative = [[0]*M for _ in range(Q+1)]

        # BFS to distribute X + k*D to all descendants
        q = deque()
        q.append((F, 0))
        while q:
            node, k = q.popleft()
            earnings[node] += X + k*D
            for child in tree[node]:
                q.append((child, k+1))

        # Update businessman totals for this year
        for b in range(1, M+1):
            for factory in businessman_factory[b]:
                businessman_cumulative[year][b-1] += earnings[factory]

        # Compute cumulative sums up to year
        for b in range(M):
            businessman_cumulative[year][b] += businessman_cumulative[year-1][b]

    # Determine the answer for each businessman
    result = []
    for b in range(M):

        for year in range(1, Q+1):
            if businessman_cumulative[year][b] >= threshold[b]:

                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            result.append("rekt")

    print('\n'.join(result))
